concepts.title: 햇살 드는 호텔 복도, 정면으로 걸어오기
concepts.background: 창으로 햇살이 드는 긴 호텔 복도 한 곳, 연한 토프 벽과 짙은 월넛 바닥, 복도 끝에서 앞으로 걸어오는 자리
concepts.background_en: A long, empty hotel corridor with warm walnut wood floor, plain muted taupe walls and a row of tall windows on the left letting in soft afternoon sun, a vanishing point at the far end, no people, no signs, no text.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 복도 정면에서 조금 떨어져 촬영, 멈출 때 전신이 화면 높이의 약 65%, 카메라 고정
concepts.light: 오후 3시쯤 창으로 들어오는 부드러운 햇살, 따뜻한 베이지 색감
concepts.motion: 걷기 (정면으로 걸어와 멈춰 포즈, 옆으로 퇴장)
concepts.why: 핑크 트위드부터 블랙 롱코트, 아이보리 퍼까지 색이 갈리는 코디라 차분한 토프 벽과 월넛 바닥이 옷 색을 가리지 않고 받쳐 줌
concepts.pace: 보폭 중간, 1초에 약 2걸음, 어깨 힘 빼고 당당하게
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye level (about 1.5 m high), about 8 m from where she stops, looking straight down the corridor, vertical 9:16, no zoom, no shake, no movement.
concepts.pace_en: Confident relaxed walk, medium strides, about two steps per second, arms swinging gently, shoulders level and loose, no bouncing or waddling.
concepts.light_en: Soft warm afternoon sunlight from the tall windows on the left, gentle shadows, warm beige tones.
concepts.direction_en: Walking straight toward the camera from the far end of the corridor, stopping at the middle of the frame, then exiting out of frame to the right.

shots.action: 복도 끝에서 걸어와 가운데서 멈춘 뒤 오른쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 가운데서 멈춰 오른손으로 숄더백 끈 고쳐 잡고 카메라 보기
shots.motion_en: 0-2.5s: she walks toward the camera with medium strides, about two steps per second, growing from about 30% to about 55% of the frame height, arms swinging loosely. 2.5-3.5s: she slows and stops at the middle of the frame at about 60% of the frame height, feet together, facing the camera. 3.5-4.5s: with her right hand she slides up the shoulder bag strap and settles it on her shoulder, then looks at the camera with a small smile. 4.5-5.5s: she walks out of frame to the right with a natural stride. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands.
shots.start: 복도 끝 가운데, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 30%, 걷는 중
shots.start_en: Tiny full-body figure at the far end of the corridor, horizontally centered, about 30% of the frame height, mid-stride with the left foot forward and arms swinging naturally at her sides, looking ahead toward the camera; not posing yet.

shots.action: 복도 끝에서 걸어와 가운데서 멈춘 뒤 오른쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 멈춰서 양손 손끝으로 퍼 카라를 쓸어 만지기 (코트는 여민 채)
shots.motion_en: 0-2.5s: she walks toward the camera with medium strides, about two steps per second, growing from about 30% to about 55% of the frame height, arms swinging loosely. 2.5-3.5s: she slows and stops at the middle of the frame at about 60% of the frame height, feet together, facing the camera. 3.5-4.5s: both hands brush the fur collar lightly with the fingertips from the sides toward the front, the coat stays closed as in the reference, then she looks at the camera. 4.5-5s: she walks out of frame to the right with a natural stride. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands.

concepts.title: 오후 햇살 드는 연습실, 제자리 가벼운 춤
concepts.background: 한쪽 벽이 연한 더스티 블루로 칠해진 빈 연습실 한 곳, 밝은 원목 바닥, 정면 벽 앞 같은 자리
concepts.background_en: An empty bright dance practice room with a plain dusty blue painted wall facing the camera, light oak wood floor, soft sunlight patches on the floor from a window outside the frame, no mirrors, no people, no signs, no text.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 벽 정면에서 조금 떨어져 촬영, 전신이 화면 높이의 약 65%, 카메라 고정
concepts.light: 늦은 오후 창으로 들어온 부드러운 햇살, 맑고 차분한 푸른 색감
concepts.motion: 가볍게 춤추기 (제자리 리듬 타기, 마지막에 한 바퀴 돌기)
concepts.why: 블랙·아이보리·브라운이 많은 코디라 더스티 블루 벽이 옷 색과 겹치지 않고 윤곽이 또렷함. 제자리 춤이라 돌 때 옷 자락과 신발이 잘 보임
concepts.pace: 무릎을 살짝 굽혔다 펴며 1초에 약 2번 리듬, 어깨와 팔은 가볍게
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye level (about 1.5 m high), about 6 m from her, facing the blue wall, vertical 9:16, no zoom, no shake, no movement.
concepts.pace_en: Light easy dance in place: knees bend slightly about twice per second, shoulders sway gently left and right, arms swing loosely, feet stay within a small area, no big jumps.
concepts.light_en: Soft late-afternoon sunlight from the left, gentle patches of light on the oak floor, clean cool blue tones.
concepts.direction_en: She stays in place at the center of the frame facing the camera and dances on the spot; at the end of the clip she steps out of frame to the left.

shots.action: 제자리에서 리듬 타다가 한 바퀴 돌고 왼쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 리듬 타며 오른손으로 가방 끈 튕기듯 잡기
shots.motion_en: 0-1.5s: she begins an easy rhythm on the spot, knees bending slightly about twice per second, shoulders swaying, arms swinging loosely, staying at about 60% of the frame height. 1.5-3.5s: keeping the rhythm, her right hand holds the shoulder bag strap and lightly bounces it with the beat while the left arm swings. 3.5-4.5s: she turns once slowly on the spot and ends facing the camera. 4.5-5.5s: she steps lightly out of frame to the left. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands.
shots.start: 화면 가운데 전신이 화면 세로의 약 62%, 서 있는 상태
shots.start_en: Full body standing at the horizontal center of the frame, about 62% of the frame height, facing the camera, weight on the left foot, arms relaxed at her sides, feet shoulder-width apart, still before the dance starts; no pose yet.

One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands.

concepts.title: 해 질 녘 나무 문 앞, 문에서 나와 걸어가기
concepts.background: 연한 세이지 그린 벽에 짙은 원목 문이 있는 조용한 건물 입구 한 곳, 평평한 돌 포장길, 같은 자리
concepts.background_en: A quiet building entrance at early evening: a plain sage green painted wall with a dark solid wooden door on the right side, flat stone-paved ground in front, a warm wall lamp glowing beside the door, no people, no signs, no text, the path continues to the left.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 길 건너에서 찍은 듯한 거리, 멈출 때 전신이 화면 높이의 약 65%, 카메라 고정
concepts.light: 해 질 무렵의 따뜻한 벽등과 푸른 저녁 하늘빛, 차분한 녹색과 갈색 색감
concepts.motion: 걷기 (문에서 나와 가운데서 멈춰 포즈, 왼쪽으로 퇴장)
concepts.why: 같은 문에서 한 벌씩 나오며 옷이 바뀌는 흐름. 세이지 그린 벽이 핑크·아이보리·블랙을 모두 또렷하게 받쳐 줌
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye level (about 1.5 m high), about 7 m from the wall, facing it squarely, vertical 9:16, no zoom, no shake, no movement.
concepts.pace_en: Steady relaxed walk, medium strides, about two steps per second, arms swinging gently, shoulders level, no bouncing or waddling.
concepts.light_en: Warm wall lamp glow beside the door, soft blue evening sky light, calm green and brown tones.
concepts.direction_en: She opens the door on the right side of the frame, steps out, walks to the center of the frame, stops, then walks away to the left and exits the frame.

shots.motion_en: 0-1.5s: she lets go of the door and walks out of the doorway toward the center of the frame with medium strides, about two steps per second, arms swinging loosely. 1.5-2.5s: she stops at the center at about 60% of the frame height, feet together, facing the camera. 2.5-3.5s: with her right hand she slides up the shoulder bag strap and settles it, then glances at the camera. 3.5-5.5s: she walks to the left along the wall with a natural stride and exits the frame. One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands.

shots.start_en: Standing in the open wooden doorway on the right side of the frame, full body about 60% of the frame height, facing the camera, one hand on the door edge, about to step out; not posing yet, no clothing adjustments.
